title: FP&A and CFO Advisory Services
summary: Budgets, rolling forecasts, scenarios, cash planning and lender and investor packs, without a full-time CFO.
metaTitle: FP&A and Virtual CFO Services for Growing Businesses
metaDescription: Outsourced FP&A and CFO advisory: annual budgets, rolling forecasts, scenario modelling, 13-week cash forecasts and lender and investor reporting.
heroIntro: Planning and decision support: a finance partner in the room when decisions get made, without the cost of a full-time CFO.
overview: Financial planning and analysis connects your actual numbers to the decisions ahead: hiring, pricing, expansion, funding. We build budgets and forecasts from your books, model the scenarios that matter and hold a regular review so the plan stays alive.
whatWeDo: Build annual budgets and rolling forecasts tied to your actual numbers.
Model scenarios such as pricing changes, new hires, expansion and loan repayment.
Run unit economics and margin analysis by product, service or location.
Forecast cash over 13 weeks and plan working capital.
Prepare lender and investor reporting packs.
Hold a monthly review call with a decision list and owners.
whoFor: Businesses planning a raise, an expansion or a bank facility.
Founders who want a finance partner without a full-time CFO.
Growing teams where lenders and investors are asking questions.

byPlan.growth: Budget vs actual in the MIS and a 13-week forecast.
byPlan.cfo: Full FP&A with rolling forecasts and scenarios.

faqs.q: Do I need the CFO plan for FP&A?
faqs.a: Full FP&A with rolling forecasts and scenarios is part of the CFO tier. Growth includes budget vs actual and a 13-week cash forecast, and Foundation clients can buy FP&A work as a project.

faqs.q: Is a monthly review call included?
faqs.a: Yes on the CFO tier (monthly) and Growth tier (quarterly), with a decision list and owners.
